key_features: 【10 Ft Heavy Duty Extension Cord】- 10ft power strip is made of pure copper, which has better current carrying capacity (15A). This extension cord is UL approved with only 0.35-inch flat wall plug and 45-degree right angle design, this flat outlet extension cord is much thinner than traditional plugs. Flat plug power strip can close to the wall easily and hide in the back of furniture, bed or refrigerators, save every space for your home.

【10-IN-1 Extension Cord with Multiple Outlets】- The slim power strip with 6 AC surge protector outlets (15A/1875W) and 4 usb ports (3.1A/15V), provide ample space for multiple devices and adapters to be plugged in simultaneously. It can charge your cellphone, laptop, tablet, cameras without a variety of converters, save your space and make your desktop organized. Suitable for the home, office, and college dorm room essentials.

【2 USB- C Fast & Smart Charge】- Added extra 2 USB C ports for your devices, the power strip with USB C ports can charge up to 5V/3A. USB-A ports can charge up to 5V/2.4A Max. With smart charging technology, the outlet extender can auto-detects your devices and reach faster charging efficiency, perfectly fit for your iphone, ipad, tablet, bluetooth earphone etc.

【Easy Mount on Wall and Desk 】- Mountable power strip with unique screw fixation design on both end, allow this white compact extension cord securely installed in various applications (4 screws included). It is easy for mounting to walls, desks or furniture. Keep your desktop organized. The low profile extension cord also can be stable on your desktop or nightstand without slipping off, the flat extension cord makes it lighter than ordinary power strip.

【Multi Safety Protection with ON/OFF Switch】- This power strip has surge protection (1080J), overload protection, short-circuit protection, over-current protection, short-circuit protection to help keep your devices safe. The on/ off switch can automatically shut off when the power exceeds rated value, to protect your expensive devices like computers, TV etc. ETL safety certified, with extension cord and other major components certified by UL.
